decision.reasoning_trace: I selected the TECWARE Phantom 87 Key Mechanical Keyboard as the final choice due to its high rating of 4.6 and large number of reviews (5974), indicating a reliable and well-liked product. The consideration set was chosen based on the presence of a full mechanical keyboard in the product description, as opposed to just keycaps or accessories. I excluded products with low review counts or ratings, as well as those that were not directly related to mechanical keyboards.
